description: We creating the game LUNA: The last light a simulation game of a rover on a moon surface
summary:
LUNA: The Last Light is an interactive lunar exploration simulation game that allows players to experience the challenges of exploring the Moon. Players take on the role of a mission planner, making decisions about landing sites, terrain navigation, rover operations, resource exploration, and mission survival.

The game uses NASA lunar science and real-world datasets to inform its terrain visualization and mission scenarios, helping players understand how scientific information supports space exploration. Through an interactive 3D lunar environment, players can explore the Moon's surface, identify potential hazards, and make decisions that affect mission success.

LUNA addresses the challenge of making complex space exploration concepts more accessible through an engaging, hands-on experience. By combining gaming, scientific data, and problem-solving, it encourages curiosity about space, develops critical thinking, and introduces players to the challenges faced by real lunar exploration missions.

Project Details — LUNA: The Last Light

PROJECT DEMO VIDEO: https://youtu.be/Pco7N4utyYg

DEPLOYED PROJECT LINK: https://luna-the-last-light.vercel.app/

PROJECT REPOSITORY: https://github.com/nadd88/LUNA-the-last-light


PROJECT SLIDES: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ou31m3Q0GeArNlL9SUBQ_rJ86RXsA7ez/view?usp=drive_link

What does it do and how does it work?

LUNA: The Last Light is an interactive lunar exploration simulation game that allows players to experience the challenges of planning and carrying out a Moon mission. Players take on the role of mission planners, selecting landing sites, analysing lunar terrain, navigating a rover, managing resources, and completing exploration objectives. The game uses a 3D lunar environment to make exploration more visual and interactive. NASA lunar science and datasets inform relevant terrain features and mission scenarios.

What are its benefits?

LUNA makes space exploration more engaging and easier to understand. Instead of only reading about lunar missions, players learn through interactive decisions and experience how terrain, hazards, sunlight, and limited resources can affect mission success.

What is its intended impact?

Our goal is to encourage interest in space science, technology, and STEM education. We want to make lunar exploration accessible to students, beginners, and people interested in space, while developing their problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

What tools and technologies were used?

We developed the project using JavaScript, React, Vite, and Three.js. These technologies support the interactive user interface, game logic, and 3D lunar environment. We also used Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.

How is the project creative?

LUNA combines space exploration, simulation, and interactive gameplay into one experience. Its NASA-inspired Mission Control interface and 3D lunar surface allow players to explore scientific concepts through realistic mission-planning scenarios rather than traditional educational materials.

What factors did our team consider?

We considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, gameplay simplicity, user experience, performance, and educational value. We aimed to balance realistic lunar exploration challenges with intuitive controls and clear instructions so that both experienced gamers and beginners can enjoy the experience.
